title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (Jan 12): Perth, Budapest & many more
description:
🔍 Description
Get ready, pilots! 🛩️ This week’s MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update brings a fantastic lineup of new airports and scenery releases for PC, and in this video I’ll walk you through all the highlights you don’t want to miss.

We’ll explore the latest additions, including:

- ORBX YPPH Perth International Airport – a major hub brought to life with high‑fidelity detail.
- South Oak Co LHBP Budapest Airport – a beautifully crafted European gateway.
- Devinci RJBE Kobe Airport – a stunning Japanese coastal airport.
- XWindStudios KTTN Trenton Mercer Airport – a fresh regional addition for US flyers.
- NMG Simulations FAKM Kimberley & KCMI Willard Airport – new options for your domestic routes.
- DreamScenery Berlin & Shanghai New Lights 2024 – dramatic night‑lighting upgrades for two iconic cities.

Whether you're into long‑haul operations, regional hops, or scenic VFR adventures, this week’s drop has something for every type of simmer. I’ll break down what’s new, what stands out, and which items might be worth adding to your hangar or scenery library.

❓ Question of the day: Are you picking up the new lighting mods? Let me know below! 👇
